title: User Recover Request
description: Send a password recovery e-mail to an RMS user. Requires the 'member of administrators' right.

username.description: Login e-mail of the account that should receive the recovery e-mail.

referrer.description: Optional page URL used as the base of the reset link, so the owner lands on a known page after opening it. Only the path part is used. Defaults to the base URL configured for the site.
